G1300.def: from «1223» and «5055»; to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist:--continue.

G1301.def: from «1223» and «5083»; to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly:--keep.

G1302.pos: 1. through, by, with, because of, for the sake of
G1302.def: from «1223» and «5101»; through what cause ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.

G1303.def: middle voice from «1223» and «5087»; to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest):--appoint, make, testator.

G1304.def: from «1223» and the base of «5147»; to wear through (time), i.e. remain:--abide, be, continue, tarry.

G1305.def: from a compound of «1223» and «5142»; nourishment:--food.

G1306.def: from «1223» and «826»; to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day):--dawn.

G1308.pos:
1. to bear or carry through any place
  2. to carry different ways
    1. to carry in different directions, to different places
      1. of people who are carried hither and thither in a ship, driven to and fro
    2. to differ, to test, prove, the good things that differ,
      1. to distinguish between good and evil, lawful and unlawful, to approve of things that excel, to differ from one
      2. to excel, surpass one
    3. impersonally, it makes a difference, it matters, is of importance
G1308.def: from «1223» and «5342»; to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass:--be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value.

G1309.def: from «1223» and «5343»; to flee through, i.e. escape:--escape.

G1310.def: from «1223» and a derivative of «5345»; to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate:--blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.

G1311.def: from «1225» and «5351»; to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert):--corrupt, destroy, perish.

G1313.def: from «1308»; varying; also surpassing:--differing, divers, more excellent.

G1314.def: from «1223» and «5442»; to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect:--keep.

G1315.def: from «1223» and a derivative of «5495»; to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon:--kill, slay.

G1316.et: from (1223) and the middle voice of (5563)
G1316.def: from «1223» and the middle voice of «5563»; to remove (oneself) wholly, i.e. retire:--depart.

G1318.def: from «1321»; (subjectively) instructed, or (objectively) communicated by teaching:--taught, which ... teacheth.

G1319.def: from «1320»; instruction (the function or the information):--doctrine, learning, teaching.

G1320.def: from «1321»; an instructor (genitive case or specially):--doctor, master, teacher.

G1321.et: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb dao (to learn)
G1321.def: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb dao (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application):--teach.

G1322.def: from «1321»; instruction (the act or the matter):--doctrine, hath been taught.

G1324.def: prolongation from «1364»; double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian:--Didymus.

G1325.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an altern. in most of the tenses)
G1325.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection):--adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.

G1326.def: from «1223» and «1453»; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively):--arise, awake, raise, stir up.

G1327.def: from «1223» and «1841»; an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge):--highway.

G1329.def: from «1223» and «2059»; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate:--expound, interpret(-ation).

G1330.def: from «1223» and «2064»; to traverse (literally):--come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through.

G1331.def: from «1223» and «2065»; to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation:--make enquiry foreign

G1332.def: from «1364» and «2094»; of two years (in age):--two years old.

G1333.def: from «1332»; a space of two years (biennium):--two years.

G1334.def: from «1223» and «2233»; to relate fully:--declare, shew, tell.

G1336.et: neuter of a compound of (1223) and a derivative of an alternate of (5342)
G1336.def: neuter of a compound of «1223» and a derivative of an alternate of «5342»; carried through, i.e. (adverbially with «1519» and «3588» prefixed) perpetually:--+ continually, for ever.

G1337.def: from «1364» and «2281»; having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet:--where two seas meet.

G1338.def: from «1223» and the base of «2425»; to reach through, i.e. penetrate:--pierce.

G1339.def: from «1223» and «2476»; to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene:--go further, be parted, after the space of.

G1340.def: from «1223» and a derivative of «2478»; to stout it through, i.e. asservate:--confidently (constantly) affirm.

G1341.def: from «1342» and «2920»; a just sentence:--righteous judgment.

G1342.def: from «1349»; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous).

G1343.def: from «1342»; equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification:--righteousness.

G1344.def: from «1342»; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent:--free, justify(-ier), be righteous.

G1345.def: from «1344»; an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision:--judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.

G1348.def: from a derivative of «1349»; a judger:--judge.

G1349.def: probably from «1166»; right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution):--judgment, punish, vengeance.

G1350.et: probably from a primary verb diko (to cast)
G1350.def: probably from a primary verb diko (to cast); a seine (for fishing):--net.

G1351.def: from «1364» and «3056»; equivocal, i.e. telling a different story:--double-tongued.

G1352.def: from «1223» and «3739»; through which thing, i.e. consequently:--for which cause, therefore, wherefore.

G1353.def: from «1223» and «3593»; to travel through:--go throughout, pass through.

G1354.def: from Dionusos (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian:--Dionysius.

G1355.def: from «1352» and «4007»; on which very account:--wherefore.

G1356.et: from the alternate of (2203) and the alternate of (4098)
G1356.def: from the alternate of «2203» and the alternate of «4098»; sky-fallen (i.e. an aerolite):--which fell down from Jupiter.

G1357.et: from a compound of (1223) and a derivative of (3717), meaning to straighten thoroughly
G1357.def: from a compound of «1223» and a derivative of «3717», meaning to straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic restauration:--reformation.

G1358.def: from «1223» and «3736»; to penetrate burglariously:--break through (up).

G1359.et: from the alternate of (2203) and a form of the base of (2877)
G1359.def: from the alternate of «2203» and a form of the base of «2877»; sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri:--Castor and Pollux.

G1360.def: from «1223» and «3754»; on the very account that, or inasmuch as:--because (that), for, therefore.

G1361.def: from the alternate of «2203» and «5142»; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity:--Diotrephes.

G1362.def: from «1364» and (probably) the base of «4119»; two-fold:--double, two-fold more.

G1365.def: from «1364»; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion):--doubt.

G1366.def: from «1364» and «4750»; double-edged:--with two edges, two-edged.

G1368.def: from «1223» and hulizo hoo-lid'-zo (to filter); to strain out:--strain at (probably by misprint).

G1369.def: from a derivative of «1364»; to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate):--set at variance.

G1370.def: from a derivative of «1364» and «4714»; disunion, i.e. (figuratively) dissension:--division, sedition.

G1371.et: from a compound of a derivative of (1364) and a derivative of temno (to cut)
G1371.def: from a compound of a derivative of «1364» and a derivative of temno (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely:--cut asunder (in sunder).

G1372.def: from a variation of «1373»; to thirst for (literally or figuratively):--(be, be a-)thirst(-y).

G1374.def: from «1364» and «5590»; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose):--double minded.

G1377.et: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb dio (to flee; cf the base of (1169) and (1249))
G1377.def: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb dio (to flee; compare the base of «1169» and «1249»); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute:--ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.

G1378.def: from the base of «1380»; a law (civil, ceremonial or ecclesiastical):--decree, ordinance.

G1379.def: from «1378»; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule:--be subject to ordinances.

G1380.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb, doko {dok'-o} (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; cf the base of (1166)) of the same meaning
G1380.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, doko dok'-o (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of «1166») of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly):--be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow.

G1381.def: from «1384»; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve:--allow, discern, examine, × like, (ap-)prove, try.

G1382.def: from the same as «1384»; test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness:--experience(-riment), proof, trial.

G1383.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «1382»; a testing; by implication, trustworthiness:--trial, trying.

G1384.def: from «1380»; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved:--approved, tried.

G1385.et: from (1209) (through the idea of holding up)
G1385.def: from «1209» (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber:--beam.

G1388.et: from an obsolete primary verb, dello (probably meant to decoy
G1388.def: from an obsolete primary verb, dello (probably meaning to decoy; compare «1185»); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile:--craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.

G1389.def: from «1388»; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate:--handle deceitfully.

G1390.def: from the base of «1325»; a present:--gift.

G1391.def: from the base of «1380»; glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective):--dignity, glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.

G1392.def: from «1391»; to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application):--(make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.

G1394.def: from the base of «1325»; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift:--gift, giving.

G1395.def: from the base of «1325»; a giver:--giver.

G1396.et: from a presumed compound of (1401) and (71)
G1396.def: from a presumed compound of «1401» and «71»; to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue):--bring into subjection.

G1398.def: from «1401»; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary):--be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).

G1399.def: feminine of «1401»; a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily):--handmaid(-en).
